description: Run a user-requested shell script as ubuntu on an active pilot VM (sudo is available). Both pilots start as plain Ubuntu: install only the database or app the user requested. Database access goes through the active website pilot, which must exist first. No direct database Internet access: if packages are needed, use a temporary package proxy on the website and remove it afterwards. Never print passwords or private keys. Output is limited to 64 KiB. Long-running apps must use a service manager. This action has no automatic retries; reuse request_key and inspect get_private_vps_action after a timeout. This does not create a paid resource.
name: exec_private_vps
title: Run a command on a pilot VPS
